title: Semi-synthetic pilot: real covariates and labels (UCI Adult), fixed semi-synthetic missingness, setting C
status_label: PRE-REGISTERED before the data are read; the data have never been opened in this project

preregistration.report_regardless: All pre-registered quantities are reported whether or not any ranking reversal occurs. The dataset, binning, models and mask rules must not be changed after the data are seen; any change would be a new, separately labelled exploratory analysis.

questions.P1: Does complete-case random dropout rank A and B in the same order as the held-out natural-missingness risk difference?
questions.P2: What sign category does the setting-C identified set have at each pre-registered Gamma_cc (finite-population identification)?
questions.P3: Does the conservative outer 95% interval keep that category?

preregistration.independent_unit: entity (unique attribute tuple excluding fnlwgt); split by hash, so duplicates never cross the split
stop_conditions: coarsening check fails -> estimand invalid, report and stop
wall time > 120 s -> remaining parts NOT_RUN

data.name: UCI Adult (Census Income)
data.license_expected: CC BY 4.0 (to be confirmed on the UCI page at download time and recorded)

label: income > 50K (trailing '.' in adult.test stripped)

models.A: Laplace-smoothed P(Y=1 | X_r=x_r) on train (Bayes under MCAR dropout)
models.B: train-mode imputation of missing binned modality, then Laplace-smoothed P(Y=1 | X=x)
